headline: Monarch Networth recommends five stocks with potential gains
summary: Monarch Networth Capital issued BUY ratings for five companies heading into Q3FY27, projecting price increases between 26% and 51%. TajGVK Hotels leads the brokerage's picks with the highest forecasted upside, followed by Godawari Power & Ispat. Aditya Vision, Capillary Technologies, and Carborundum Universal round out the list with expected gains of 26% each. Retail investors tracking brokerage recommendations may evaluate these targets against their own portfolios.
why_it_matters: Brokerage picks may drive near-term retail interest
winners_losers: Listed stock holders gain / cautious investors unaffected

headline: Monarch Research forecasts 49% upside for TajGVK Hotels despite recent stock decline
summary: TajGVK Hotels shares have dropped 26% over the past year, yet Monarch Research remains bullish with a projected 49% upside. The brokerage expects revenue and EPS to grow at a CAGR of 26.4% and 15.4% respectively from FY26 to FY29E. The valuation is pegged at 8x FY29E EV/EBITDA, though risks such as project delays and heavy reliance on the Hyderabad market remain. Indian retail investors tracking hospitality stocks should weigh these growth forecasts against regional concentration risks.
why_it_matters: Brokerage pegs potential upside for beaten-down hotel stock.
winners_losers: TajGVK shareholders gain / cautious investors wait

headline: Monarch Capital issues Buy call on TajGVK Hotels
hook: Brokerage issues bullish call on hotel chain
summary: Monarch Capital has issued a Buy recommendation for TajGVK Hotels. Brokerage calls provide external analysis on a company's growth potential and valuation. Indian retail investors tracking hospitality stocks can review this recommendation alongside company fundamentals.
why_it_matters: External brokerage recommendation may influence short-term retail trading interest.
